svg.aria-label: A Claude Code session: a request to translate a closure notice for older members in Addis Ababa. The skill loads, converts the date to the Ethiopian calendar, and writes a polite Amharic notice with the Ethiopian date and clock.
svg.title: A Claude Code session: a request to translate a closure notice for older members in Addis Ababa. The skill loads, converts the date to the Ethiopian calendar, and writes a polite Amharic notice with the Ethiopian date and clock.

g.text: translate this for our community center's telegram channel.
members are mostly in addis, a lot of older folks too.
ቢሮአችን ለጥገና ስራ ዓርብ ጥቅምት 28 ቀን 2018 ዓ.ም. (እ.ኤ.አ. ኖቬምበር 7 ቀን 2025) ዝግ ይሆናል።
አገልግሎት የሚጀምረው ሰኞ ከጠዋቱ 3:00 ሰዓት (9:00 a.m.) ነው።
